      hyperbolicLaplacian (quarticContactResidual q 4) (coordinates z) ∂D4BMModularCore.measure)=
      (physicalAngularParameter r^2-1/4)*∫ z : UpperHalfPlane,
        scalar (physicalAngularParameter r) (coordinates z)*quarticContactResidual q 4 (coordinates z)
          ∂D4BMModularCore.measure := by
  have h := (quarticResidualCoreCutoff_physical_pairing_tendsto q r 4).const_mul
    (physicalAngularParameter r^2-1/4)
  have he : (fun n : ℕ => ∫ z : UpperHalfPlane, scalar (physicalAngularParameter r) (coordinates z)*
      (quarticResidualCoreCutoff q 4 n).laplacian.field z ∂D4BMModularCore.measure)=
      fun n => (physicalAngularParameter r^2-1/4)*∫ z : UpperHalfPlane,
        scalar (physicalAngularParameter r) (coordinates z)*(quarticResidualCoreCutoff q 4 n).field z
          ∂D4BMModularCore.measure := funext (fun n => (quarticResidualCoreCutoff_physical_green q r 4 n).2.2)
  rw [← he] at h
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (quarticResidualCoreCutoff_H_physical_laplacian_tendsto q r) h

/-- The original physical finite part, retaining its unchanged native Mellin subtraction. -/
def quarticNativePhysicalPeriod (q : XiZeroCopy) (slot : Fin 6) : ℂ :=
  (∫ z : UpperHalfPlane, scalar (physicalAngularParameter q) (coordinates z)*
    quarticContactResidual q slot (coordinates z) ∂D4BMModularCore.measure)-
    reflectedCompletedLambda ((q.1:ℂ)-1)*∑ j : Fin 5, quarticPrincipalCoefficient q slot j*
      nativeCutoffMellinContinuation (quarticPhysicalMellinExponent q j)

/-- Exact native physical Green transport of H: all original cusp and source-cutoff contacts are included. -/
theorem quarticNativePhysicalPeriod_H_green (q : XiZeroCopy) :
    quarticNativePhysicalPeriod q 5=(physicalAngularParameter q^2-1/4)*quarticNativePhysicalPeriod q 4 := by
  let mu : ℂ := physicalAngularParameter q^2-1/4
  have hmu : mu=(q.1:ℂ)*((q.1:ℂ)-2)/4 := by
    dsimp only [mu]
    rw [physicalAngularParameter_eq]
    ring
  have hc (j : Fin 5) : quarticPrincipalCoefficient q 5 j=
      quarticPrincipalExponent q j*(quarticPrincipalExponent q j-1)*quarticPrincipalCoefficient q 4 j := rfl
  have hs : (∑ j : Fin 5, quarticPrincipalCoefficient q 4 j*
      (quarticPrincipalExponent q j*(quarticPrincipalExponent q j-1)-mu)*
        nativeCutoffMellinContinuation (quarticPhysicalMellinExponent q j))=
      (∑ j : Fin 5, quarticPrincipalCoefficient q 5 j*
        nativeCutoffMellinContinuation (quarticPhysicalMellinExponent q j))-
      mu*(∑ j : Fin 5, quarticPrincipalCoefficient q 4 j*
        nativeCutoffMellinContinuation (quarticPhysicalMellinExponent q j)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [hc]
    ring
  have hk := quarticPrincipalCutoffContact_physical_integral q 4
  rw [← hmu,hs] at hk
  have hg := quarticContactResidual_H_physical_green q q
  simp_rw [quarticContactResidual_H_laplacian,mul_sub] at hg
  rw [integral_sub (quarticContactResidual_scalar_integrable q 5 (physicalAngularParameter q))
    (quarticPrincipalCutoffContact_scalar_integrable q 4 (physicalAngularParameter q)),hk] at hg
  unfold quarticNativePhysicalPeriod
  dsimp only [mu] at hg
  linear_combination hg

end

def radialCoordinate (r : ℂ) : ℂ := 1-r⁻¹^2

theorem radialCoordinate_original (x : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    radialCoordinate (x 1) = D4BMMetricReconstruction.bmCoordinate x := rfl

/-- The coordinate derivatives are derived before transporting the wave operator. -/
theorem radialCoordinate_derivatives {r : ℂ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt radialCoordinate (2/r^3) r ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => 2/u^3) (-6/r^4) r := by
  constructor
  · convert! (((hasDerivAt_id r).inv hr).pow 2).const_sub 1 using 1
    dsimp
    field_simp
  · convert! ((hasDerivAt_const r (2:ℂ)).div ((hasDerivAt_id r).pow 3)
      (pow_ne_zero 3 hr)) using 1
    dsimp
    field_simp
    ring

/-- The independent-frequency original wave expression in radial jets. -/
def radialWave (w lambda r v d dd : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  w^2*v-(r^2-1)^2*dd-2*r*(r^2-1)*d+(r^2-1)/r^2*lambda*v

/-- Exact coordinate transport to the physical BM master, retaining frequency,
angular value, both coordinate derivatives and the source multiplier. -/
theorem radialWave_physical (w chi r v d dd : ℂ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hf : r^2-1 ≠ 0) :
    radialWave w (1/4+chi^2) r v ((2/r^3)*d) ((2/r^3)^2*dd-(6/r^4)*d) =
      -4*radialCoordinate r*D4BMPhysicalMaster.radialJet (Complex.I*w) chi
        (radialCoordinate r) v d dd := by
  have hz : radialCoordinate r ≠ 0 := by
    unfold radialCoordinate
    field_simp
    exact div_ne_zero hf (pow_ne_zero 2 hr)
  dsimp [radialWave,D4BMPhysicalMaster.radialJet,radialCoordinate] at hz ⊢
  field_simp [hr,hz]
  ring_nf
  simp only [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

factor when entering the physical radial equation. -/
theorem radial_source_normalization (r C : ℂ) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    -2*(r^2-1)/r^3*C = -4*radialCoordinate r*(C/(2*r)) := by
  dsimp [radialCoordinate]
  field_simp
  ring

  cases side <;> cases branch <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,physicalRate]

      onsetPulseTransform (2*physicalRate q branch-physicalFundamentalFrequency q side+2*(n:ℂ)) := by

/-- No duration is selected: for every actual copy and each original branch/side choice,
both fixed onset factors are nonzero at all sufficiently high physical overtones. -/
theorem physicalOvertone_fixedOnset_eventually_ne_zero (q : XiZeroCopy) (branch side : Bool) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n →
      clearedOnset (physicalRate q branch) (physicalOvertoneFrequency q side n) ≠ 0 ∧
      continuedOnset (physicalRate q branch) (physicalOvertoneFrequency q side n) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := onsetPulseTransform_overtone_eventually_ne_zero
    (2*physicalRate q branch-physicalFundamentalFrequency q side)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hc : clearedOnset (physicalRate q branch) (physicalOvertoneFrequency q side n) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [physicalOvertone_clearedOnset_eq]
    exact hN n hn
  refine ⟨hc,?_⟩
  let w := physicalOvertoneFrequency q side n
  let s := physicalRate q branch
  have hs : w-2*s ≠ 0 := physicalOvertoneFrequency_sub_sourceRate_ne_zero q branch side n
  have he : clearedOnset s w = (w-2*s)*continuedOnset s w := by
    unfold clearedOnset continuedOnset

  apply hc
  change clearedOnset s w=0
  rw [he,hz,mul_zero]

theorem physicalOvertone_all_fixedOnsets_eventually_ne_zero (q : XiZeroCopy) :

      clearedOnset (physicalRate q branch) (physicalOvertoneFrequency q side n) ≠ 0 ∧
      continuedOnset (physicalRate q branch) (physicalOvertoneFrequency q side n) ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  choose N hN using physicalOvertone_fixedOnset_eventually_ne_zero q
  refine ⟨max (max (N false false) (N false true)) (max (N true false) (N true true)),?_⟩
  intro n hn branch side
  cases branch <;> cases side <;> apply hN _ _ n <;> omega
